scope: Experiment 1 body-only four-image inference reference conditioning
model: Hrlrvo checkpoint-013000 with existing VAE, transformer, Global LoRA and C4 compressor

implementation.reference_stream: four separately VAE-encoded one-frame full-canvas samples, B=4 T=1 sigma=0, one frozen transformer forward
implementation.cache: projected block-local Global K/V, immutable CPU storage, current block copied to accelerator
implementation.target_read: target Q to reference K/V in Global branch only
implementation.temporal_policy: repeat each reference spatial lattice at every target latent time using that target time's RoPE
implementation.blend: compressed Global target output lerp reference-attended output alpha=0.1
implementation.write_mask: apply only to generated tokens; center Anchor and left/right endpoint tokens use target-only Global output

selection_tool.policy: sharpest exterior frame in each of four fixed B00 temporal strata

proved: four distinct content-hashed references and separate-one-frame VAE contract
all block cache capture and CPU immutability
Anchor and explicit endpoint known-mask preservation

open_quality_limit: The checkpoint was not trained for this reference role; the full 1025-frame run is the empirical test.
